suite: Focused dialogue logic (DOM/render doubles; fake reminder clock)

results.name: Initial instruction appears once; full text stays until acknowledgement
Enter and NumpadEnter each advance exactly one line, held/repeated keys do not
A held final Enter cannot activate unrelated controls or a new sequence
Caption click and accessible Continue activation advance once
Locked-pointer clicks advance and are consumed before game actions
The gameplay click opening dialogue cannot also advance its first line
Reminder appears at 10 seconds once, never dismisses or advances text
Advancing hides reminder immediately and starts a fresh 10-second timer
Pause/resume preserves remaining reminder time and blocks dialogue input
Reader/keypad overlays suspend captions, leave Enter for the keypad, then restore
Tab visibility and focus each suspend timing without dismissing text
Overlapping gameplay thoughts append in order instead of replacing unread lines
Clearing/restarting drops queued text, reminders and stale completion callbacks
Era narrative cards use the same instruction, reminder and click progression
Normal HUD notifications expire independently without advancing or blocking dialogue
prologue: every original line stays in order; later events and ending wait for acknowledgement
wakeUp: every original line stays in order; later events and ending wait for acknowledgement
epilogue: every original line stays in order; later events and ending wait for acknowledgement
Cancelling a waiting cinematic never runs its completion or later actions
